annotations.title: List the visits on a feed site now

description: For a Live Visit Feed site: the visits on the site right now, from the live board. Each carries its `visit_id`, when it started and was last seen, and the moment, elapsed time and score of its last feed event. A visit is listed once it opened a feed: a real gesture or a conversion, never a bounce, a crawler or a driven browser. It needs an API key from the developer console and the feed turned on for the site; a conversion site's credential is refused with not_feed_site. `interest` is the site's own model's score, 0 to 1, with `model` naming the model; both are null until the site has one. `preview_score` is a score trained on purchases, not on the site's goals; it is null on a site that has its own model. All three are null unless the site turned scoring on. `control_group: true` marks the permanent holdout: Cromanion never acts on those visits, and the feed still describes them. An ended visit stays listed for ten minutes. Six calls a minute per key, a budget of its own; every call is on the developer's record before it runs. Pass a `visit_id` to get_visit for the visit's whole last event.
name: list_live_visits

visits.description: Most recently active first. Each: visit_id (pass to get_visit), started_at, last_seen_at, ended, control_group, visitor_kind (human · ai_agent), converted, last_moment `{kind, page}`, elapsed_s, interest and model (the site's own model's score and its name; null without one), preview_score (the purchase-trained score; null on a site with its own model). All three are null without the site's scoring consent.
